title: Find what makes this test flaky
prompt: This Playwright test fails about once in ten CI runs, never on the author's laptop. Select **every line** that makes it flaky or unreliable. (Assume the app itself works.)
hints: Look for a line whose action is never waited for.
Look for a fixed wait, and for a value that is read once instead of asserted with a retrying matcher.
Think about which other tests might use a group with that exact name, at the same time, on four workers.
